applies_why: This judge text resolves a challenger's seed/loins chain against a defender's chain by saying each is footed.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse
room: by footing, never verse by verse: one reading forbids rejecting a footed chain because it does not explicitly name Joseph, while the other treats such non-naming as a footing gap that may be weighed.
why: The judge calls the challenger's chain footed yet treats its not naming Joseph as a reason for underdetermination, imposing a verse-stating requirement rather than resting on footing.
